site.name: Malcolm Liew Jia En
site.summary: Computer Engineering undergraduate at the Singapore Institute of Technology with a Diploma in Game Design and Development and hands-on experience shipping full-stack web, desktop, mobile, and embedded software. Builds end-to-end products across React, TypeScript, Python, Electron, Flutter, and Unity, with a strong foundation in data structures, algorithm analysis, and optimisation. Experienced in integrating AI and LLM services (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Agnes AI), computer vision models (YOLOv8, MobileCLIP), cloud and backend platforms (Supabase, Vercel, Docker, Cloudflare), and robotics tooling (ROS 2, MQTT, WebRTC, LiDAR). Two-time hackathon builder and former web developer and game design intern, with proven cross-functional communication, data integrity, and event leadership skills. Interested in software engineering, data analytics, and process optimisation.

projects.title: Deployer
projects.tools: Python, TypeScript, Docker, WSL2, MariaDB, MongoDB, Caddy, Cloudflare, C#
projects.text:
Built an open-source, self-hosted backend and deployment platform (similar to Supabase + Vercel) that runs on an ordinary Windows PC with as little as 4 GB RAM, installed via a single command or a one-click installer.
Implemented user authentication with email/password, Google and GitHub OAuth, and account linking, plus role-based access control (owner, admin, developer, viewer), single-use invite links, and an audit log for team collaboration.
Provisioned managed SQL (MariaDB) and NoSQL (MongoDB) databases per project with restricted database users, and support for external databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB Atlas.
Developed a schema viewer that renders ER diagrams in crow's-foot notation across SQL and NoSQL sources, with convention checks, cross-database links, and DDL export (.sql and mongosh scripts).
Built a browser-based data browser and query console (SQL and mongosh) with role-based read-only enforcement for viewers.
Designed a project-scoped REST data API with API keys (read-only anon and read/write service keys) usable from curl, JavaScript, and Python.
Implemented GitHub push-to-deploy: repository webhooks, automatic build detection (static, Node.js, Python, Dockerfile), zero-downtime deployments behind a Caddy reverse proxy, rollbacks, and build and runtime logs.
Added encrypted backups, point-in-time recovery, safety snapshots, and full encrypted export and import for migrating installations between devices.
Enabled secure remote access and custom domains through automated Cloudflare Tunnel and DNS configuration, with no port forwarding required, plus support for attaching spare PCs as host devices.
Wrote a PowerShell installer and a C# WinForms setup application (.NET Framework 4.8) that checks system requirements, configures Docker Engine inside WSL2, generates secrets locally, and supports dry-run mode; set up CI releases publishing container images to GitHub Container Registry.
Authored an AI-agent skill enabling coding agents to back websites with Deployer, and wrote pytest API tests and technical documentation.

projects.title: Fitz
projects.tagline: AI Wardrobe and Outfit Planner · SMU Agnes AI Hackathon 2026
projects.tools: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Hono, Supabase, Google Gemini, Agnes AI, Vercel
projects.text:
Built a fully functioning, mobile-first AI wardrobe and styling web application that recommends daily outfits using the user's own clothes, deployed on Vercel.
Integrated Google Gemini computer vision to generate a personalised colour profile (undertone, contrast, recommended colours) from a user photo and to classify garments by category, colour, and pattern, with privacy-aware prompting that avoids sensitive inferences.
Integrated Agnes AI for wardrobe-grounded outfit generation ("Dress me") and AI virtual try-on image generation ("Try it on"), letting users preview pairings before committing and reducing impulsive purchases and textile waste.
Incorporated live weather data from the Open-Meteo API into outfit recommendation prompts for context-aware suggestions.
Designed a swipe-based mix-and-match outfit grid with item locking and local caching for session continuity.
Built a Hono API on Node.js deployed as Vercel serverless functions, with Supabase for authentication, storage, and wardrobe data, and Supabase Edge Functions for "Style Jams" collaborative event outfit planning.
Engineered graceful degradation with an AI service health check and status banner so core features remain usable when generative AI services are unavailable.

projects.title: Yahboom Robot
projects.tagline: Edge AI Object Detection and Robot Control Dashboard
projects.tools: Python, Flask, React, TypeScript, ROS 2, MQTT, WebRTC, YOLOv8, MobileCLIP, Raspberry Pi, LiDAR
projects.text:
Developed a monorepo robotics stack comprising a React and Vite web dashboard, a Flask backend, and Raspberry Pi scripts for a Yahboom robot car.
Implemented real-time camera streaming over WebRTC and MQTT frame relay, and an MQTT-to-ROS 2 bridge for movement commands, autonomous exploration, and drive status.
Built a LiDAR-based obstacle safety node and LiDAR grid and SLAM views in the dashboard.
Implemented and compared two object detection pipelines for emergency stopping: server-side YOLOv8 (Ultralytics) inference on live frames, and a Cache Aware Offloading (CAO) pipeline using MobileCLIP-S1 vision transformer embeddings on the Pi with image-to-image cosine similarity matching against a reference library.
Designed a Stop-Time Test Bench with configurable detection modes, similarity thresholds, embedding sizes (512/1024/2048 B), simulated network hop delay, and CSV export for benchmarking edge versus cloud inference latency.
Built a customisable widget-based dashboard with layout templates, an event log, and a REST API for video, VIT embeddings, YOLO, and test bench control.

projects.title: The Daily Grind
projects.tagline: AI Productivity and Onboarding Workspace · strAIght up! Hackathon 2026
projects.tools: React, TypeScript, Vite, Electron, SQLite, IndexedDB, OpenAI, Gmail API, Tailwind CSS
projects.text:
Built a fully functioning AI-integrated web application designed to reduce intern handholding by automatically breaking down tasks and guiding new hires through onboarding independently.
Developed a local-first productivity workspace with an overview dashboard, priorities view, unified message inbox, and settings, using React 18, React Router, and React Context for state management.
Implemented browser persistence with Dexie (IndexedDB) for tasks, channels, messages, calendar, and kanban data, and a desktop build using Electron with a local SQLite database (better-sqlite3) and an IPC bridge.
Integrated Gmail, Telegram, and OpenAI in the Electron main process to ingest messages and triage them into prioritised, actionable tasks.
Built drag-and-drop task management with dnd-kit and an accessible UI with Radix UI, shadcn-style components, and Tailwind CSS 4; packaged a Windows installer released on GitHub.

projects.title: AutoResume
projects.tagline: ReadyTalent Job Scraper and AI Resume Tailoring
projects.tools: TypeScript, React, Electron, Google Gemini, Node.js
projects.text:
Built a Windows desktop application that scrapes job listings (title, company, salary, required skills, description) from SIT's ReadyTalent career portal and stores them locally.
Automated sign-in through SIT's ADFS single sign-on in a hidden Electron window, calling the portal's own job API with incremental scraping of only new jobs; encrypted saved credentials with Windows DPAPI.
Integrated Google Gemini to extract ATS keywords from job descriptions and generate tailored, ATS-optimised A4 resumes and cover letters, with three printable templates and PDF export.
Served the app over a local network server so tablets (Android/iPad) can use it as a Progressive Web App on the same Wi-Fi; wrote a scraper self-test against a mock portal API.

projects.title: Thermal Printer Label Editor
projects.tagline: Label designer that prints raw TSPL to a Gprinter GP-3120TL
projects.text:
Built a Windows desktop application for designing and printing thermal labels on a Gprinter GP-3120TL, sending raw TSPL commands so the printer driver does not alter the layout.
Developed a live WYSIWYG label canvas with rulers, snap guides, drag, resize, align, rotate, layering, grouping, and undo/redo for text, lines, images, and input fields.
Implemented image processing for thermal output (threshold, dithering, invert), custom TTF/OTF font import, and media settings for size, gap, density, speed, and print direction.
Built a template system with saved designs, fillable input fields, auto-incrementing serial number fields, saved fills, and print-width warnings; supported light and dark themes and packaged a Windows installer.

projects.title: Singapore MRT Routing Optimiser
projects.tagline: Tour optimisation across the 163-station MRT network
projects.tools: Python, Dijkstra's Algorithm, Ant Colony Optimisation, Branch and Bound
projects.text:
Designed a full routing optimisation system for Singapore's 163-station MRT network, implementing Nearest Neighbour, Branch and Bound, and Ant Colony Optimisation (ACO) solvers from scratch.
Pre-processed the sparse transit graph with Dijkstra's algorithm to generate an all-pairs travel-time matrix.
Tuned ACO hyperparameters (α, β, ρ) through systematic benchmarking, achieving near-optimal tours in under 0.1 seconds.

projects.title: DSA Benchmarking Suite
projects.tagline: Data Structures and Algorithms benchmarking CLI · INF1008
projects.text:
Built a menu-driven CLI suite for INF1008 Data Structures and Algorithms covering linked lists, complexity analysis, recurrences, and sorting.
Implemented a polynomial linked list and a hybrid data structure (HashList, FastHashList, HybridList) achieving O(1) amortised access on a singly linked list, validated and benchmarked on datasets of up to 100,000 elements.
Benchmarked FFT O(n log n) and brute-force SAT O(2ⁿ) implementations against theoretical growth ratios.
Built a divide-and-conquer MRT system sensor monitoring simulation satisfying the recurrence T(n) = 3T(n/2) + log n.
Compared stable and unstable sorting (merge sort versus quicksort) and implemented bucket sort on dataset files, with benchmark charts generated in Matplotlib.

projects.title: Stock Analysis Toolkit
projects.tagline: NVIDIA price analysis (2020–2024) · INF1002 group project
projects.text:
Built an end-to-end stock analysis toolkit processing historical NVIDIA price data (2020–2024) as a group project for INF1002 Programming Fundamentals.
Developed a CSV ingestion pipeline with data validation, cleaning, and optimised tuple-based storage.
Implemented Simple Moving Average (SMA), daily returns, trend detection, and a single-pass O(n) maximum profit algorithm with live trading state management.
Visualised price trends and indicators using Matplotlib, and packaged a one-click launcher for non-technical users.
